regime.skew: put-rich in the wings (+2.48 at 10-delta) but near-flat at 25-delta (+0.44)
regime.label: Long-gamma cage drained 74% in four sessions; spot sits on the +29 knife edge at 1070 with the whole sub-spot strip short gamma
evidence: +29 net GEX at the 1070 ATM strike is 0.3% of the +8,740 stacked at 1080/1090/1100, so dealers are effectively flat gamma exactly where price is trading and long gamma only above it - rallies get dampened, declines do not.

-7,288 cumulative net GEX below 1070 makes every strike from 990 to 1060 trend-amplifying; the deepest pocket is 1050 at -2,789, which is also the 2,013-contract near put wall that support would have to be found at.

2.36 P/C OI is the highest of the last 12 sessions (range 2.14-2.36), built on +2,043 put contracts over five sessions against -87 calls; heavy put OI here is insurance parked on the burden map, not a directional vote.

15.49% 10-delta put IV against 13.00% 10-delta call IV prices the left tail 2.48 points rich while 25-delta skew is only +0.44 - crash insurance is bid, near-money is balanced, which is the Protection signature rather than a pin.

S50U26.today_summary: 1070.4 closed 5.1 points lower, 0.4 points from the 1070 max pain that has been welded in place for eight of the last nine sessions - spot came to the anchor, the anchor did not pull it. Net dealer GEX halved again, 5,733 to 3,080, and every point of that cushion now sits above the market: 1080/+3,234, 1090/+2,401, 1100/+3,105 against 1050/-2,789 and 1060/-1,770. 1,823 put contracts traded for a net put OI change of only -109, with 1060 shedding 133 puts on 504 lots while 1070 added 84 on 322 - protection was rolled, not added. Call OI closed at both upside walls, 1100 -145 on 224 lots and 1080 -104 on 300, thinning the dampening block by 286 contracts even before price moved; the 16,321-contract 910 put wall again fails the Vol2Vol filter on zero volume, zero gamma and a stale 30.91% IV, so it carries no hedging force.
what_changed: Net GEX fell 5,733 to 3,080, a 46% one-day drop and 74% below the +11,678 peak of 2026-09-09 - the 1100 strike alone gave back 899 units as 145 calls were closed.
ATM IV expanded 0.82 points to 13.41% from 12.59%, the second straight rise off the 12.21% series low of 2026-09-11, widening the 1-sigma day from 8.53 to 9.04 points.
Gap from spot to the 1100 gamma flip widened to 29.6 points from 6.7 on 2026-09-09, moving price three 1-sigma days away from the level where dealer hedging turns stabilising.
P/C volume cooled to 1.18 from 1.44 as put volume fell 409 lots to 1,823 while call volume was flat at 1,547 - the tape is quieter than the 5-day positioning shift implies.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Net dealer GEX has collapsed 74%, +11,678 on 2026-09-09 to +3,080 today, while the future fell 12.9 points from 1083.3 - the long-gamma cushion that held the 1070-1100 cage through early September is being spent rather than rebuilt, and the gamma flip drifted the wrong way, 1090 to 1100, as it happened. Put OI added 2,043 contracts over the same five sessions, 42,856 to 44,899, against call OI -87, lifting P/C OI from 2.24 to a 12-session high of 2.36. ATM IV bottomed at 12.21% on 2026-09-11 and has expanded 1.20 points to 13.41% as price fell 12.0 points, reversing the 14.09% to 12.21% compression that ran from 2026-09-03 - IV rising with put flow and falling price is the Vol2Vol confirmation that the near-money put strip is live, even though today's own put volume produced no net OI build. Max pain has not moved off 1070 in eight of nine sessions and both walls are frozen - 2,784 calls at 1100 and the structural 16,321 puts at 910 have not migrated in 12 sessions - so the regime change is entirely in the gamma distribution, not in where OI is parked. The cage that dampened 1070-1100 on 2026-09-11 is now a one-sided ceiling: the same structure caps rallies into 1080-1100 and leaves anything below 1070 unhedged.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1060 / 1040
strategies.rationale: The neutral-gamma / Protection / normal-IV cell of the matrix calls for defined-risk downside insurance, and the -7,288 cumulative GEX below 1070 means a slip through the 2,013-contract 1050 near put wall forces dealers to sell into weakness rather than absorb it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = the 4.20-point net debit at mid (7.50 paid for 1060, 3.30 received for 1040); max value 20 points, breakeven 1055.8.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close above 1080, where +3,234 net GEX puts dealers back on the dampening side.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1090 / 1100
strategies.rationale: 1100 is a triple confluence - the 2,784-contract call wall, the gamma flip and the +3,105 GEX peak - and the 1090 short strike is the 25-delta call at 13.49% IV, so this sells the exact level the remaining long-gamma block defends.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 10-point width minus about 1.80 points of net credit at mid = roughly 8.20 points; breakeven 1091.8.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close above 1100 - through the wall and the flip together, the short-gamma-above-the-wall squeeze case from the heatmap zones.

strategies.name: Combined 1060/1040 put debit financed by the 1090/1100 call credit
strategies.rationale: Assembling the two legos expresses the asymmetry directly - capped above 1080 by +8,740 of dealer long gamma, unhedged below 1070 by -7,288 - and cuts the cost of carrying the hedge from 4.20 to 2.40 points.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 12.40 points, realised above 1100 (10-point call-spread width plus the 2.40-point net debit); max value 17.60 points below 1040.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close above 1080; the structure is fully impaired above 1100.

S50U26.prediction: 1050-1085 is the base case into the 2026-09-29 expiry, with the 10 remaining sessions implying a 28.6-point 1-sigma cone of 1042-1099: the +3,234 and +3,105 gamma blocks at 1080 and 1100 dampen rallies, while the 1050 near put wall is the first real support 20.4 points - 2.3 daily sigma - below spot. The asymmetry points down, because a close below 1050 drops price into the -5,518 cumulative-GEX pocket where dealer hedging sells into the decline, with 1040 and 1030 the next OI shelves. A daily close above 1080 invalidates the downside lean and re-arms the dampening block that has capped every rally since 2026-09-09.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position size is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1070 max-pain anchor and the 1080-1100 gamma ceiling as tendencies, not guarantees. With 14 days to the 2026-09-29 expiry and ATM IV already expanding 1.20 points off its 12.21% low, macro or news flow can override the option structure outright - and defined risk is not risk-free, the stated max losses are real and can be taken in full.
